story_text:
## Hands-on Reviews
## Typing Sound Test
## Theme It with What You Love
## Custom-Molded Switches & Keycaps for Light
Standard clear switches cast harsh shadows around opaque magnets. We custom-tooled our housing with optical-grade PC to channel light cleanly around the core—minimizing dark spots and internal scatter.
## Side-Printed Keycaps: Clearly Visible.
Designed with an optimal 7°– 8° typing angle, our side-printed legends naturally face your line of sight from a standard sitting posture.
## 5.48" Under-Switch OLED, Your Personalization Hub
We engineered a full 5.48-inch diagonal span beneath the keyways to give dynamic motion art and cinematic loops room to breathe, bypassing the pixel limitations of generic miniature displays.
## Touch-Ready Control at the Top
Positioned safely outside the typing strike-zone, the top capacitive strip gives you tactile-free access to core controls. Fine-tune actuation points on the fly, launch essential apps, and manage media playback with a single swipe, without ever interrupting your active workflow.
## Glow Beyond the Keys
## Independent Under-Switch Lighting
Beyond synchronized themes, the under-switch LEDs can be isolated and customized independently. Dial in standalone static tones, breathing rhythms, or reactive effects tailored strictly to your typing flow.
## A Soft Halo Across Your Desk
The top ambient glow and bottom illumination synchronize seamlessly with the under-switch display, projecting a soft halo across your desk.
## Looks Playful, Plays Powerful
Ultimate gaming performance meets breathtaking visual expression. Aesthetics and core functionality are thoughtfully decoupled, ensuring stunning displays never sacrifice your competitive edge.
## Fun at Fingertips - Magnetic Speed You Can Feel
Stop faster, counter-strafe cleaner, and keep every reset close to your fingers. VESTRA VISION makes magnetic control feel playful, sharp, and ready for ranked nights.
## 0.01 mm RT Precision, 0.01-4 mm Adjustable Actuation
Dial In Your Controls for Pinpoint Strafing.
## 8K Polling Rate
The keyboard reports input data up to 8,000 times per second.
## TMR Magnetic Sensor
Unlike traditional Hall-effect sensors that build up micro-heat and drift over time, ultra-low-power TMR (Tunnel Magnetoresistance) sensors stay cool under heavy loads. Delivering higher signal-to-noise ratio and pure linear accuracy, every actuation point and Rapid Trigger reset stays pixel-perfect throughout marathon sessions.
## Massive Offline Storage for Endless Customization
Hardware-Level Storage: Store your personal assets locally without relying on background software overhead.
Instant Switching: Cycle effortlessly between themes and animations using on board hotkeys right in the heat of battle.
## Display and Input Work Independently
## Why not full screen?
The display is deliberately concentrated on the right, preserving the primary left-hand gaming zone in a pure, uncompromised magnetic-switch architecture for natural ergonomics and surgical control.
## Will the Display Impact Latency? Never.
We engineered a completely decoupled, dual-processor architecture. A dedicated display engine powers the screen pipeline, entirely isolated from the primary input MCU. Keystroke scanning, TMR sensor calculation, and Rapid Trigger tracking run on an exclusive, unimpeded hardware channel.
## Fun to Tweak - KANALI
## Make It Personal, Make It Iconic
Customize OLED visuals, lighting, actuation settings and profiles.
## Unlock Ultimate FPS Dominance
Powered by advanced firmware, we turn raw magnetic data into intelligent in-game logic. Supporting advanced key functions like RS, DKS, SOCD, TGL and MT, it's deeply optimized for FPS titles like Valorant and CS: GO to elevate your tactical control.
## See KANALI in Action
## TouchScreen Components Adding and Switching
## Key Remapping: Tailored Layouts for Ultimate Efficiency
Key remapping breaks free from rigid traditional layouts, allowing you to reassign any key to function keys, shortcuts, or custom commands based on your workflow.
## Brightness Adjusting & Multimedia Control
## Actuation Adjusting & RT Setting
Features a precise actuation adjustment range from 0.01mm to 4.0mm, supporting independent per-key configuration. Powered by advanced RT technology, keys reset the exact moment you lift your finger.
## Advanced Key: SOCD
SOCD acts like a smart referee for your directional keys. When you press opposite keys (like A and D) at the same time, it instantly prioritizes the last one you pressed to eliminate conflicts.
## RGB Light Setting & Shortcut Key Switching
## Made to Match - In Black & Silver
Two colors. One flawless gaming and typing experience. Pick the one that speaks to you.
## INSIDE THE BOX
## Specifications
## Choose Your Reward
## Shipping Policy
Important Notice for US Backers: Due to varying tax regulations across different U.S. states, we are unable to collect state sales tax at the initial Kickstarter checkout. Instead, applicable state taxes will be calculated and collected later during the post-campaign survey stage.
*Shipping is not available to addresses in U.S. territories(Puerto Rico (PR)/Guam (GU)) or military addresses (APO/FPO).
## Timeline
## Design Story
From OLED CPU Cooler to OLED Keyboard —— The Evolution of Desktop Interaction
When we first introduced the TRYX PANORAMA, our goal was simple yet ambitious: to break the static boundaries of PC hardware. By bringing a curved, high-resolution AMOLED display to an AIO liquid cooler, we gave your CPU a voice, turning the heart of the PC into a canvas for real-time telemetry, personalized art, and dynamic expression.
The response was overwhelming. It proved something fundamental: enthusiasts don't just want performance; they want a desktop that feels alive, cohesive, and deeply personal.
Yet, as we looked across the desk, we realized a glaring disconnect. The CPU cooler lived behind the glass panel, distant and observational. But the true focal point of interaction, the command center where your fingers actually meet the machine, remained bound by conventional limitations.
It was time to bring the visual revolution directly to your fingertips.
## From the Factory Floor
## About TRYX
At TRYX, we build gaming hardware for players who want performance to feel exciting, personal, and fun. VESTRA VISION brings that idea into the keyboard itself: fun on screen, fun at your fingertips, and fun to tweak long after the first unboxing.
With a transparent magnetic switch structure, a 5.48-inch OLED visual layer, touch-ready interaction, and deep software tuning, VESTRA VISION turns the keyboard from a tool into a live part of the player's setup - without giving up the speed serious gamers expect.
risks: Timing is always the most challenging factor regarding the production of a new product. Sometimes things didn’t go exactly as planned – the supplier misses a deadline, a machine breaks down, or the terrible weather that go against the logistics. At all events, we promise make all effort to ensure the shipment of all rewards by the estimated date; as we are working with top-notch suppliers and have padded our timeline to make sure the time frames can be laid out as we expected. Every penny of your pledge amount counts and decides how far can we go. Let us DOUBLE YOUR SUPPORT by simply share our campaign with your friends on any social media!

faq.a:
To claim your reservation, please follow the simple steps below:
● Step 1. Create your account on Kickstarter and log in, then visit the VESTRA VISION Campaign Page.
● Step 2. Simply choose [Super Early Bird] reward and complete the pledge. (That is all!)
*Please note that we will match the backer with our pre-order customer list. Do use the Kickstarter account that connects with your reservation email.

To pledge on Kickstarter, here are the detailed steps:
1. Login with your Kickstarter.
2. Find a project that interests you and click the “Back this Project” button. Then select your reward and shipping country.
3. Enter your payment information. Then click the “Pledge” button and you’ll be all set.
Kickstarter won't charge your card until the END of the campaign, which means you can take advantage of reserving your VESTRA VISION first and think things over later.

faq.q: How can I change my pledge or reward grade?
faq.a:
Simply 2 steps:
1. Visit the project page and click the “Manage your pledge” button that appears next to your pledge amount.
2. On the next page, select "Change your pledge" and then change your pledge amount.

faq.q: Is the OLED display just a small status screen?
faq.a: No. VESTRA VISION uses a 5.48-inch OLED visual layer beneath transparent switches, making the display part of the keyboard's main visual experience.

faq.q: Does the OLED affect typing or gaming input?
faq.a: The OLED visual layer and Hall-sensing magnetic switch input are designed to work independently, so dynamic visuals do not block normal key triggering.

The main under-switch OLED is for the visual layer. Touch interaction should be presented through the top display for quick controls, such as launching apps, fine-tuning actuation, and managing media.
Yes. The software direction includes theme upload, visual switching, and profile management, subject to final software feature confirmation.
Players and keyboard enthusiasts who want competitive magnetic performance plus a more personal, expressive desktop setup.
